scene beachmasseven1
: Oh Io! You’re sure back early.
lines.zh: : 哦，Io！你回来得真早。

lines.en: : Yes, but not because I want to be.
lines.zh: : 是的，但不是因为我愿意。

lines.en: scene beachmasseven2
: Guess I can’t blame ya for not being able to function without the aid of your trusty companion and best friend forever, Uta Ushi-
lines.zh: : 我想也不能怪你，毕竟没有你那位可靠的同伴、永远的挚友 Uta Ushi 陪在身边，你就没法正常运转——

lines.en: : I just walked in on Sana with her fingers so deep inside of herself that I think she may have been trying to pull out her uterus.
lines.zh: : 我刚刚撞见 Sana 把手指插进自己身体里，深到我觉得她可能是想把子宫给掏出来。

lines.en: scene beachmasseven3
: You what?
lines.zh: : 你什么？

lines.en: : Where is the nearest maintenance shed? And what do you think the chances are that I will be able to find some bleach in there that I can use to fix my eyes?
lines.zh: : 最近的工具间在哪儿？你觉得我在里面找到漂白水、用来修好我眼睛的概率有多大？

lines.en: : Io is obviously lying. Sana is too innocent to ever do anything like that and I refuse to believe it’s true.
lines.zh: : Io 显然在撒谎。Sana 太纯洁了，绝不可能做那种事，我拒绝相信这是真的。

lines.en: : You sure it was Sana you saw in there and not somebody more, uhh...horny? Like Kirin or Nodoka?
lines.zh: : 你确定你看到的是 Sana，而不是某个更……呃……饥渴的人？比如 Kirin 或者 Nodoka？

lines.en: : I know what I saw, but I wish I didn’t.
lines.zh: : 我知道我看到了什么，但我宁可我不知道。

lines.en: : You’re on drugs. That makes you an unreliable source. It’s not true.
lines.zh: : 你嗑药了。这让你成了不可靠的消息来源。这不是真的。

lines.en: scene beachmasseven4
: Sensei, I’d hate bein’ the one to break the illusion that some girls just truly are innocent and not interested in stuff like that, but the fact of the matter is that Sana’s got needs too.
lines.zh: : 老师，我其实不想打破"有些女孩子真的很纯洁、对那种事没兴趣"的幻想，但事实是，Sana 也是有需求的。

lines.en: : But is it normal for those “needs” to take over in a public restroom?
lines.zh: : 可那些"需求"在公共厕所里发作，这正常吗？

lines.en: scene beachmasseven5
: Now, that’s just unsanitary.
lines.zh: : 那可就太不卫生了。

lines.en: : I don’t know if I should keep being upset or if I should be saying “I told you so” in response to your “No cumming on Christmas” proclamation.
lines.zh: : 我不知道该继续难过下去，还是该对你那句"圣诞不许射"的宣言回一声"我早说过吧"。

lines.en: scene beachmasseven6

: Well...on the bright side, at least it was Io that found her and not you! Now you can keep her all angelic and pure inside of your mind and...pretend she never does the same things that...literally all of us do.
lines.zh: : 嗯……往好处想，至少是 Io 撞见她的，不是你！这样你还能让她在你心里保持天使般的纯洁……然后假装她从来不会做……我们所有人其实都会做的事。

lines.en: : That side isn’t bright at all. It’s dark and full of sorrow. I will never be able to unsee this.
lines.zh: : 那一点都不算好处。那一面又黑又充满悲伤。我这辈子都没法把那一幕从脑子里删掉了。

lines.en: scene beachmasseven7
: Oh, come on. Walkin’ in on a girl in the middle of, uhh...private time ain’t the end of the world, is it?
lines.zh: : 拜托。撞见一个女孩子正处在……呃……私人时间里，又不是世界末日，对吧？

lines.en: : Ask Sensei. He’s just as shocked as I am and he wasn’t even there for it.
lines.zh: : 你问问老师。他跟我一样震惊，而他当时根本不在场。

lines.en: : Everything I know is a lie.
lines.zh: : 我所知道的一切都是谎言。

lines.en: scene beachmasseven8
: Y-You know, you guys are makin’ a much bigger deal out of this than it actually is! I’m sure Sana ain’t thrilled to have been discovered in the heat of the moment either!
lines.zh: : 你……你们把这件事闹得比实际严重多了！我相信 Sana 也不乐意在最上头的时候被人撞见啊！

lines.en: : You’re right. She’s probably still too busy digging the rest of her arm out of her vagina.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。她大概还在忙着把剩下的那条胳膊从阴道里挖出来。

lines.en: : I bet this is Sara’s fault somehow. That is the only explanation.
lines.zh: : 我敢说这肯定是 Sara 的错。这是唯一的解释。

lines.en: : Yeah, I’m sure it doesn’t have anything to do with the guy who’s been going around and trying to corrupt all of us girls one by one.
lines.zh: : 是啊，肯定跟那个到处转悠、想把我们这些女生一个个带坏的家伙毫无关系。

lines.en: scene beachmasseven9
: Are you saying she was masturbating to me? Because I think I can be a little more comfortable with this if that is the case.
lines.zh: : 你是说她是想着我在自慰？如果是这样，我觉得我好歹能舒服一点。

lines.en: : How the heck am I supposed to know?! I can’t read minds! I just don’t want everybody thinking Sana’s some kind of perverted freak just cause she decided to rub one out in the bathroom!
lines.zh: : 我他妈怎么知道？！我又不会读心！我只是不想大家因为她在厕所里打了一发，就觉得 Sana 是个变态怪胎！

lines.en: : This is obviously a thing we need to keep secret! Cause if somebody ever found me going to town on myself like that, I sure as heck wouldn’t want people going around and gossiping about it!
lines.zh: : 这显然是我们必须保密的事！因为要是有人撞见我在自娱自乐成那样，我绝对不想别人到处去传闲话！

lines.en: : But it would be hot if you did that. Sana is a completely different story. She’s too small and delicate.
lines.zh: : 但如果是你那样的话会很性感。Sana 就完全是另一回事了。她太小太纤弱了。

lines.en: : She’s only an inch shorter than me! Don’t say I’m not delicate just cause my features started coming in early!
lines.zh: : 她只比我矮一英寸！别因为我发育得早，就说我不够纤弱！

lines.en: : Why would it make any difference if it was you Sana was thinking about? I don’t see how it changes the fact that she was literally masturbating in a public bathroom.
lines.zh: : Sana 想的是你又能有什么区别？我看不出这能改变她在公共厕所里自慰这个事实。

lines.en: : It wouldn’t change that fact, but at least it would allow me to distract myself.
lines.zh: : 是改变不了这个事实，但至少能让我转移一下注意力。

lines.en: : From what? Not thinking about sex? Because it’s okay to do that every once in a while, Sensei. You’re not going to suddenly burst into flames if you don’t have an erection.
lines.zh: : 从什么上转移？不去想性？老师，偶尔不想那种事也没关系的。你没有勃起也不会突然自燃。

lines.en: : How can you be so sure?
lines.zh: : 你怎么这么确定？

lines.en: scene beachmasseven10
: Ugh, forget it. I don’t want to talk about this anymore. It’s gross.
lines.zh: : 呃，算了。我不想再聊这个了。太恶心了。

lines.en: : Well, sorry for once again ruining everything.
lines.zh: : 行吧，抱歉我又一次把一切都搞砸了。

lines.en: : Io...stop. Let’s just...hang out here for a little while longer before heading back to the inn. That should help get all of our minds off of...uhh...Sana’s habits, right?
lines.zh: : Io……别说了。我们……在这儿再多待一会儿再回旅馆吧。这样应该能让我们都忘掉……呃……Sana 的习惯，对吧？

lines.en: : For me, maybe. Sensei’s a whole other story.
lines.zh: : 对我来说也许吧。老师就是另一回事了。

lines.en: : No one look down. It’s not safe.
lines.zh: : 谁都别往下看。不安全。

lines.en: scene beachmasseven11
: Well, obviously now I’m going — wow. Hello.
lines.zh: : 好吧，看来现在我非去不可了——哇哦。你好啊。

lines.en: scene beachmasseven12
scene beachmasseven13
: Ooooh boy.
lines.zh: : 哦豁，好家伙。

lines.en: : Can I open my eyes now? Or do you two want to keep being disgusting for a little while longer?
lines.zh: : 我现在能睁开眼了吗？还是说你们俩想再恶心一会儿？

lines.en: scene beachmasseven14
: Uta.
lines.zh: : Uta。

lines.en: : Ten more seconds.
lines.zh: : 再十秒。

lines.en: scene black
Ignoring the fact that one of the girls I am most interested in copulating with just spent the last ten seconds staring at my erection through my jeans, I can’t manage to get Sana out of my head.
lines.zh: 暂且不论我最想与之交合的女孩之一刚刚花了十秒钟隔着牛仔裤盯着我的勃起看，我根本没法把 Sana 从脑子里赶走。

lines.en: But the weird part is that it’s not even in a mostly-sexual way. Like, sure there is some element of that to it, but I’m more shocked than anything else.
lines.zh: 但奇怪的是，这甚至不是主要出于性方面的原因。当然，其中确实有那么一点成分，但我更多的是震惊。

lines.en: scene beachmasseven15
And I think it’s pretty safe to say that she is as well- considering when Uta, Io and I make it to the inn about thirty minutes later, she immediately locks eyes with the one who caught her.
lines.zh: 而且我想说她也一样震惊，应该没什么问题——因为大约三十分钟后，当我和 Uta、Io 回到旅馆时，她立刻就和撞见她的那个人对上了眼。

lines.en: scene beachmasseven16
scene beachmasseven17
She then realizes that I know-
lines.zh: 然后她意识到我已经知道了——

lines.en: scene beachmasseven18
And promptly exits the room.
lines.zh: 并立刻离开了房间。

lines.en: : Wow. I’ve never heard a sliding door close with such force before.
lines.zh: : 哇。我从没听过拉门能被关得这么用力。

lines.en: : See, Uta? I told you.
lines.zh: : 看到了吧，Uta？我早说了。

lines.en: : I never doubted you! I just said it’s not something we should hold against her!
lines.zh: : 我从来没有怀疑过你！我只是说我们不该拿这件事来针对她！

lines.en: : She’s probably heading back there right now.
lines.zh: : 她现在大概正往那边赶呢。

lines.en: : Io! Leave the poor...horny girl alone! This is a confusing time in our lives!
lines.zh: : Io！别去烦那个可怜的……发情的女孩！我们正处在人生中很迷惘的阶段！

lines.en: scene beachmasseven19
: Perhaps it would be best if I went to check on her...
lines.zh: : 也许我最好去看看她的情况……

lines.en: : Oh, Senpai. Welcome home.
lines.zh: : 哦，前辈。欢迎回来。

lines.en: scene beachmasseven20
: Did you miss me? I feel like we’ve barely seen each other all day.
lines.zh: : 想我了吗？我感觉我们今天一整天都没怎么见过面。

lines.en: : Put on a bathing suit like the rest of the girls. What’s the point in having a student teacher if I can’t discreetly stare at her body in contrast to all of the students during a field trip to the beach?
lines.zh: : 像其他女生一样把泳衣穿上吧。如果去海滩郊游时不能偷偷盯着实习老师的身材、再拿它跟学生们做对比，那要实习老师还有什么意义？

lines.en: : You ain’t missing much, buddy. I might be in my twenties, but even I’m outpaced by some of these bright, young stars.
lines.zh: : 老兄，你也没错过什么。我虽然二十多岁了，可连我都被这些光鲜的年轻新星给比下去了。

lines.en: : Speaking of “bright young stars” who outpace you in the growth department, have you seen Yumi around?
lines.zh: : 说到在发育方面胜过你的"年轻新星"，你有没有看到 Yumi？

lines.en: scene beachmasseven21
: Yumi?! Nope! Hahah! Haven’t seen her all day! What a crazy thing you’d just ask me out of nowhere, Senpai! Like I’d have any idea where Yumi is! Pfft!
lines.zh: : Yumi？！没有！哈哈哈！一整天都没见过她！前辈你突然问这个也太奇怪了吧！我怎么可能知道 Yumi 在哪儿！噗！

lines.en: : You didn’t...kill her, did you?
lines.zh: : 你不会……把她杀了吧？

lines.en: scene beachmasseven22
: Nope! No murderers in this room! Least...not to my knowledge!
lines.zh: : 没有！这屋里没有杀人犯！至少……据我所知没有！

lines.en: : Then...are you two secretly fucking?
lines.zh: : 那……你们俩在偷偷上床？

lines.en: scene beachmasseven23
: Bruh. Come on. Why would you even ask that?
lines.zh: : 兄弟。拜托。你怎么会问这个？

lines.en: : Because you’re being “sus” as hell right now and I am going to get to the bottom of it.
lines.zh: : 因为你现在"可疑"得要命，我一定要查个水落石出。

lines.en: : Did you seriously just “sus” me?
lines.zh: : 你刚才真的用"可疑"来评判我？

lines.en: : You’re not the only young and vibrant teacher around here, Imani. Now, tell me where Yumi is or I’m going to demote you to school janitor.
lines.zh: : 你又不是这儿唯一一个年轻有活力的老师，Imani。快说 Yumi 在哪儿，不然我就把你贬成学校的清洁工。

lines.en: scene beachmasseven24
: You’d really send me off to my death just like that? There’s no way I’d be able to dodge Ayane’s absurdly good dodgeball skills. Besides, you don’t even have the right to demote me.
lines.zh: : 你真要就这么把我送去送死？我可躲不掉 Ayane 那好得离谱的躲避球。再说了，你根本没权力贬我的职。

lines.en: : And if anything, you’d probably be the one getting demoted since all of the staff likes me and you’re just known as the creepy guy with really entrancing eyes.
lines.zh: : 要说的话，被贬的大概是你吧，毕竟全体教职工都喜欢我，而你只是那个眼神特别勾人的变态大叔。

lines.en: : I do find myself getting lost in them rather often.
lines.zh: : 我经常发现自己会迷失在那双眼睛里。

lines.en: scene beachmasseven25
: Oh, Nodoka. You’re an omniscient weirdo. Do you have any idea where Yumi is? Because if so, Sensei wants to know. And if not, be careful yo. She could strike again at any moment.
lines.zh: : 哦，Nodoka。你这个无所不知的怪人。你知道 Yumi 在哪儿吗？如果知道，老师想知道。如果不知道，那你小心点。她随时可能再出手。

lines.en: : I’m afraid I haven’t seen her. Which is quite unfortunate as I was hoping to get a better look at her body in a more...exposed state than normal.
lines.zh: : 恐怕我没见过她。这实在遗憾，因为我本希望能以比平时更……暴露的状态好好看看她的身体。

lines.en: Certainly wouldn’t be the first time.
lines.zh: 反正也不是第一次了。

lines.en: : You’re wild. I’m not sure if my lust could ever survive through having the shit kicked out of me. But hey, hate sex is a thing and why am I talking about this with a student?
lines.zh: : 你真野。我不确定我的欲念能不能在被打得半死之后还存活下来。不过话说回来，恨爱这东西确实是存在的——还有我为什么要跟一个学生聊这些？

lines.en: : Nodoka is barely a student when she’s light years smarter than both of us.
lines.zh: : Nodoka 比我们俩聪明了不知多少个光年，她算不上什么学生。

lines.en: : That’s right. I know all about hate sex, so please feel free to continue talking about it and don’t pay me any mind if I begin softly moaning underneath my breath.
lines.zh: : 没错。我对恨爱可是了如指掌，所以你们尽管继续聊，要是我开始压着嗓子轻轻呻吟，别在意我就好。

lines.en: scene beachmasseven26
: Welp, there you have it, Senpai. Nobody’s got any idea where Yumi is. And if you just so happen to find her, don’t bring me up. Understood?
lines.zh: : 好了，就这样，前辈。没人知道 Yumi 在哪儿。万一你真找到她，别提我。明白吗？

lines.en: : You really are fucking her, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你真的在跟她上床，对吧？

lines.en: : That might be preferable to our current situation because at least I’d have some sort of control in a relationship like that.
lines.zh: : 那也许比我们现在的状况好，因为在那种关系里我至少还有点控制权。

lines.en: : Got it. You owe money to the Yakuza.
lines.zh: : 明白了。你欠了黑帮的钱。

lines.en: : Sure. Let’s just go with that.
lines.zh: : 行吧。就这么说吧。

lines.en: scene beachmasseven27
: Why are you looking for Yumi, exactly? Is there anything I could help with?
lines.zh: : 你到底为什么要找 Yumi？有什么我能帮忙的吗？

lines.en: : Perhaps the three of us could-
lines.zh: : 也许我们三个可以——

lines.en: : Nope. I’m good.
lines.zh: : 不用。我很好。

lines.en: : But you haven’t even let me finish. And you know for a fact I’d let you finish, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 可你连我说完都不让。而且你心里清楚，我会让你"说完"的，老师。

lines.en: : Was that supposed to sound lewd? Or-
lines.zh: : 你这是故意说得很色吗？还是——

lines.en: : I’d let you finish all over me.
lines.zh: : 我会让你全射在我身上。

lines.en: : Well, that answers that question.
lines.zh: : 好吧，这算是回答了那个问题。

lines.en: : Just leave Yumi alone, Nodoka. Haven’t you already done enough?
lines.zh: : Nodoka，别去招惹 Yumi 了。你做的还不够多吗？

lines.en: scene beachmasseven28
: Isn’t it the other way around? Yumi’s the one who knocked Nodoka on her ass. Nodoka didn’t do shit.
lines.zh: : 不是反过来了吗？是 Yumi 把 Nodoka 打得屁股着地。Nodoka 什么都没做。

lines.en: : There might be more to that story than you think.
lines.zh: : 这件事的内情也许比你想的要多。

lines.en: : You saying that public apology was all for shits and gigs then?
lines.zh: : 那你是说那次公开道歉全是闹着玩的？

lines.en: : Public apology? What public apology?
lines.zh: : 公开道歉？什么公开道歉？

lines.en: : The heartfelt and moving speech Yumi gave in front of the classroom that ultimately allowed her to rejoin the class. Surely you haven’t forgotten such a touching moment, have you?
lines.zh: : 就是 Yumi 在全班面前那段真挚动人的演讲，最后让她重新回到了班上。这么感人的时刻，你总不会忘了吧？

lines.en: Did...something like that really happen between Halloween and now?
lines.zh: 从万圣节到现在，真的……发生过那种事吗？

lines.en: I’ve got...no way of knowing what sort of changes Yumi went through ever since she was suspended, but...there’s no way she’d ever do something like that on her own, is there?
lines.zh: 我……无从得知 Yumi 被停学之后经历了什么样的改变，但……她绝不可能自己主动做出那种事，对吧？

lines.en: Does Nodoka have something else on her now, too?
lines.zh: Nodoka 现在又抓住她什么把柄了吗？

lines.en: : Must have just...slipped my mind.
lines.zh: : 大概是……一时想不起来了吧。

lines.en: : Well slip it back into normal gear or whatever cause she’s still on thin ice. And, if you do find some kinda dirt on her, bring it to me first so I can even our playing field again.
lines.zh: : 那就赶紧换回正常档位吧，因为她还在薄冰上呢。另外，你要是真挖到她什么黑料，先拿给我，好让我把场地重新拉平。

lines.en: : Just what the hell is going on between you two?
lines.zh: : 你们两个到底怎么回事？

lines.en: : Oh, you know. Just sex stuff. Don’t think too much about it. And again...dirt, please.
lines.zh: : 哦，你知道的。就是性方面的事。别想太多。还有……黑料，拜托了。

lines.en: scene beachmasseven29
Imani and Nodoka step away from a brightly decorated Christmas tree as I am finally faced with the reality that it truly is “the” holiday season.
lines.zh: Imani 和 Nodoka 从一棵装饰得五彩缤纷的圣诞树旁走开，而我终于直面了现实——真的到"那个"节日季了。

lines.en: And judging by the fact that Maya and Ayane are already casually hanging out at a table in front of a second Christmas tree, I assume they’ve accepted it as well.
lines.zh: 从 Maya 和 Ayane 已经悠闲地坐在第二棵圣诞树前的桌子旁来看，我想她们也已经接受了这一点。

lines.en: Ami, too — who has either forgotten that Ami time exists or has simply respawned into her typical group of girls after mysteriously vanishing earlier.
lines.zh: Ami 也是——她要么是忘了"Ami 时间"这回事，要么就是在早先神秘消失之后，重新刷新回了她那群固定的女生堆里。

lines.en: I stare down at the stack of presents and-
lines.zh: 我低头盯着那堆礼物，然后——

lines.en: : CAW! (We meet again, Father.)
lines.zh: : 呱！（我们又见面了，父啊。）

lines.en: : Okay. I guess this is happening now.
lines.zh: : 好吧。看来这事现在要发生了。

lines.en: : CAW! (This moment of splendor will be temporary. Savor it while it lasts. For it is only in moments like these that we can truly appreciate the wonders of life.)
lines.zh: : 呱！（这辉煌的时刻只是暂时的。趁它还在，好好品味吧。因为只有在这样的时刻，我们才能真正领略生命的奇迹。）

lines.en: : CAW! (But as those wonders fade and you come face to face with the unkind reflection of your mutilated self, remember-)
lines.zh: : 呱！（但当这些奇迹褪去，你直面那被肢解的自我那残酷的倒影时，请记住——）

lines.en: : CAW! (Some things are not always as they seem.)
lines.zh: : 呱！（有些事情并不总是表面上那样。）

lines.en: : CAW! (And there will always be a place for you shrouded in wires and surrounded by salt.)
lines.zh: : 呱！（总有一处为你而留的地方，那里被电线缠绕，被盐粒环绕。）

lines.en: : Noodles, why are you even here?
lines.zh: : Noodles，你为什么会在这儿？

lines.en: : CAW! (Reconnaissance.)
: And where is Tsuneyo?
lines.zh: : 那 Tsuneyo 在哪儿？

lines.en: : That’s what I’d like to know!
lines.zh: : 这正是我想知道的！

lines.en: scene beachmasseven30
: Sir, I’ve been looking all over for the Kendo Princess and I’ve yet to uncover even the faintest trace of her essence.
lines.zh: : 老师，我找遍了所有地方寻找那位剑道公主，却连她一丝气息都没能发现。

lines.en: : Have you, perchance, stumbled across her in your journeys? Perhaps with a large, yellow exclamation point over her head?
lines.zh: : 您在旅途中可曾偶然撞见过她？也许她头顶上还顶着一个大大的黄色感叹号？

lines.en: : Is she giving out quests now?
lines.zh: : 她现在开始发任务了吗？

lines.en: : It’s possible. She-
lines.zh: : 有可能。她——

lines.en: scene beachmasseven31
: Wait, why did you know what that meant?
lines.zh: : 等等，你怎么知道那是什么意思？

lines.en: : I’m not really sure.
lines.zh: : 我不太确定。

lines.en: : Sir...have you secretly been an otaku this whole time?
lines.zh: : 老师……您一直以来其实都是个御宅族吗？

lines.en: : Absolutely not. But I’ll keep an eye out for Tsuneyo and will let her know you’re looking for her if I bump into her.
lines.zh: : 绝对不是。不过我会留意 Tsuneyo 的，要是碰见她，就告诉她你在找她。

lines.en: : I appreciate that, Sir. The reward I have to offer you will not be great as this is merely a side quest-
lines.zh: : 感激不尽，老师。我能给您的报酬不会太丰厚，毕竟这只是个支线任务——

lines.en: scene beachmasseven32
: But, perhaps there is something I could make to go along with last year’s Christmas present...which I see you’re still wearing.
lines.zh: : 不过，也许我可以再做点什么，来配去年那件圣诞礼物……我看您还穿着呢。

lines.en: : Indeed I am. It’s one of my three favorite shirts.
lines.zh: : 确实还穿着。这是我三件最喜欢的衬衫之一。

lines.en: : And it brightens my day to hear you say that.
lines.zh: : 听您这么说，我这一天都亮堂了。

lines.en: : Now, if you’ll please excuse me, I have agreed to partake in a treacherous ritual where myself and several other girls will go around in a circle revealing secrets about ourselves and making bad decisions.
lines.zh: : 那么，请原谅我先走一步——我答应了要去参加一个危险的仪式：我和几个女孩围成一圈，互相爆料自己的秘密，然后做出糟糕的决定。

lines.en: : Oh, good. It wouldn’t really be a beach trip unless something terrible happened to at least one of the interpersonal relationships in this class.
lines.zh: : 哦，好极了。要是这个班里的人际关系没有至少一对出点可怕的状况，那就不算真正的海滩旅行了。

lines.en: : Right you are, Sir! And here's hoping that person is not me for the second year in a row!
lines.zh: : 您说得太对了，老师！只希望那个人别连续第二年是我！

lines.en: scene beachmasseven29
Molly makes her way back to the table and-
lines.zh: Molly 走回桌子那边，然后——

lines.en: : Sensei!
lines.zh: : 老师！

lines.en: scene beachmasseven33
Okay. I guess Rin is here now.
lines.zh: 好吧。看来 Rin 现在也来了。

lines.en: : Sensei, have you seen Futaba anywhere?
lines.zh: : 老师，你有没有在哪儿见过 Futaba？

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure I pissed her off by spending so much time on my phone and she doesn’t have a girlfriend so she didn’t bring her phone with her and now I can’t apologize.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定我光顾着玩手机把她惹毛了，而她没有女朋友，所以没带手机，现在我没法跟她道歉。

lines.en: : Wow, everyone’s just missing tonight, huh?
lines.zh: : 哇，今晚大家都在玩失踪啊？

lines.en: : Who else is missing?
lines.zh: : 还有谁不见了？

lines.en: : Yumi...Tsuneyo...Futaba...And come to think of it, I haven’t seen Otoha around either.
lines.zh: : Yumi……Tsuneyo……Futaba……这么一想，我也没见着 Otoha。

lines.en: scene beachmasseven34
: Kind of hard to see somebody who didn’t come in the first place.
lines.zh: : 一个根本没来的人，当然是见不着的。

lines.en: : What? Why isn’t she here? You’re not fighting again, are you?
lines.zh: : 什么？她为什么没来？你们又吵架了？

lines.en: : We’ve barely stopped fighting since Halloween.
lines.zh: : 从万圣节起，我们几乎就没停过吵架。

lines.en: : So in a sense, I guess it’s kind of good that she didn’t come because this would be prime “Let’s dump Rin” territory and I doubt she’d do something like that over the phone.
lines.zh: : 所以从某种意义上说，她没来反而挺好的，因为现在这种场合最适合来一句"我们跟 Rin 分手吧"，而我怀疑她不至于在电话里干这种事。

lines.en: : But also, I want her to be here so we can finally stop all this arguing and just make out or something.
lines.zh: : 但另一方面，我又希望她在这儿，好让我们终于能停止争吵，直接接吻什么的。

lines.en: : Fine. If you really want someone to make out with, I-
lines.zh: : 行吧。如果你真想找人接吻，我——

lines.en: scene beachmasseven35
: I can’t joke about that anymore. I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 这种玩笑我不能再开了。抱歉。

lines.en: : Who said I’m-
lines.zh: : 谁说我在——

lines.en: : Please don’t. Things are complicated enough as-is.
lines.zh: : 别这样。事情已经够复杂了。

lines.en: : My bad. But yeah, I’ll keep an eye out for Futaba. Especially since it seems like it is now my duty to go round all of the missing people up in one leisurely stroll around the beach.
lines.zh: : 我的错。不过行，我会留意 Futaba 的。尤其是现在看来，绕着海滩悠闲地散一圈步、把所有失踪人口都找回来，已经成了我的职责。

lines.en: : Want to come with me?
lines.zh: : 要一起来吗？

lines.en: : Me? Thanks but no thanks. I’m going to continue sulking in the bedroom. Just tell her I’m sorry if you see her, okay? I get not wanting to hang out with me. I kinda suck right now.
lines.zh: : 我？谢谢，不用了。我要继续在卧室里生闷气。你要是见到她，就跟她说声对不起，好吗？我理解她不想跟我在一起。我现在确实挺糟糕的。

lines.en: : Just stop sucking and you won’t have any problems anymore.
lines.zh: : 别再"糟糕"下去，你就不会再有问题了。

lines.en: scene beachmasseven36
: I’ll get right on that. Thanks for the pep talk, Dad.
lines.zh: : 我马上去办。多谢你的鼓励，老爸。

lines.en: : Enjoy your leisurely walk down the beach and make sure to hold Futaba’s hand if you guys wind up romantically walking back here together.
lines.zh: : 好好享受你在海滩上的悠闲漫步吧，要是你们俩最后浪漫地牵手走回来，记得牵住 Futaba 的手。

lines.en: : It’ll be a good substitute for the Christmas present you totally didn’t get her.
lines.zh: : 这可以很好地替代你压根没给她买的圣诞礼物。

lines.en: : How about I just have sex with her instead?
lines.zh: : 那我干脆跟她上床算了？

lines.en: : How about I pretend I didn’t hear that and go back to blinding myself with blue light in a dark room?
lines.zh: : 那我干脆假装没听见，回黑屋子里继续用蓝光闪瞎自己好了？

lines.en: : Wait, one last thing.
lines.zh: : 等等，最后一件事。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : Is your mom coming?
lines.zh: : 你妈妈会来吗？

lines.en: scene beachmasseven29
: Goodnight, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 晚安，老师。

lines.en: : Because if not, I can make her.
lines.zh: : 因为如果她不来，我可以让她来。

lines.en: : You and what vagina?
lines.zh: : 就凭你和你那条阴道？

lines.en: scene black
As Rin disappears back into the bedroom away from the comfort of all of her friends, I set out on yet another soon-to-be fruitless journey.
lines.zh: Rin 离开了所有朋友带来的安慰，消失回卧室里，而我踏上了又一段注定徒劳的旅程。

lines.en: And while there’s no guarantee I’ll find any of the three people I have been tasked with finding (One being a task I set myself) I can at least make sure I’m not around when things inside inevitably start cracking.
lines.zh: 虽然我不能保证能找到那三个我被托付去找的人（其中一个是自己给自己派的活），但至少我能确保，当屋子里的事情不可避免地开始崩裂时，我不在场。

lines.en: That sort of thing always happens around here. And it happens even faster when I’m present.
lines.zh: 这种事在这一带总是发生。而我在场的时候，它发生得更快。

lines.en: And so my early Christmas gift will be minding my own business for most...while figuring out a way to get involved in the business of those who I think actually need it.
lines.zh: 所以我的提前圣诞礼物，就是大部分时间都别多管闲事……同时想办法去掺和那些我认为真正需要我掺和的人的事。

lines.en: The ones who are missing-
lines.zh: 那些失踪的人——

lines.en: scene beachmasseven37
: Hngh! Mmm!....Mmf!
lines.zh: : 唔！嗯！……唔唔！

lines.en: : Mmf...no...I have...ngh! I have...to stay...quiet!
lines.zh: : 唔唔……不行……我得……嗯！我得……保持……安静！

lines.en: The ones who are missing are the ones who need me the most.
lines.zh: 失踪的那些人，才是最需要我的人。

lines.en: : Ahh.......haaaah!
But...
lines.zh: 但是……

lines.en: Maybe not all of them.
lines.zh: 也许不是所有人。

lines.en: scene black
